title: Materialize FA3 canonical model-store scan and read-only cross-provider discovery evidence
decisions: The Model Manager authority boundaries remain unchanged; this materialization is an implementation/evidence extension only.
The FA3 canonical artifact store is scanned read-only and is independent of provider-native runtime stores.
The canonical-store scan emits only relative paths and hashes a representative real artifact with full SHA-256.
The collector proves no structural canonical-store mutation by requiring identical before/after inventory manifests.
Cross-provider discovery reads local Hugging Face immutable snapshots, the LM Studio local catalog and Ollama native manifests without downloads or network access.
Discovery PASS does not canonically admit every observed model, infer compatibility, perform physical deduplication, choose model routing or place workloads.
Executable current-host PASS may only be produced by the self-hosted current-host runner and is distinct from hosted CI canonical regression PASS.
